vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.9

The skill bundle defines a standard customer support persona designed to manage tickets using Google Workspace tools via the 'gws' utility. The instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose (triaging emails, logging to sheets, and scheduling calls) and contain no evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions and requirements are internally consistent for a Google-Workspace–based customer-support persona, but you should verify the external 'gws' binary and the referenced utility skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar) before installing because those components will hold the real privileges.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (customer support: triage email, log tickets, escalate, schedule calls) match the SKILL.md instructions which call out triaging Gmail, appending to Sheets, posting to Chat, and inserting Calendar events. Requiring a GWS helper and GWS-related utility skills is coherent with the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions stay within the support workflow (run gws gmail +triage, gws sheets +append, gws chat for escalation, gws calendar +insert). The skill explicitly depends on other 'gws-*' utility skills; those utilities — not this instruction-only skill — will perform mailbox/sheet/calendar access. This skill does not itself instruct reading unrelated files or environment variables.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files (instruction-only), so nothing will be downloaded or written by this skill itself. Lower risk from installation perspective.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no env vars or credentials itself (so proportional). However, it depends on external 'gws' binary and specific gws-* skills that almost certainly require OAuth tokens / service credentials to access Gmail, Sheets, Chat, and Calendar. Verify those downstream skills' requested scopes/credentials before granting access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and default autonomous invocation are normal. The skill does not request persistent/always-on privileges and does not modify other skills or system settings in its instructions.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is an instruction-only persona that delegates all privileged actions to a 'gws' helper and the gws-gmail / gws-sheets / gws-chat / gws-calendar utility skills. Before installing: 1) Confirm what the 'gws' binary is and whether the platform provides it from a trusted source. 2) Inspect the gws-* utility skills (their source, install steps, and OAuth scopes) because they will need access to Gmail, Sheets, Chat, and Calendar — those grant broad access to your data. 3) If you cannot inspect the utilities, treat this skill as high-privilege because it implies mailbox and calendar access. 4) Note the skill's source/homepage are unknown; prefer skills with identifiable provenance. If you want lower risk, only enable this persona after reviewing and limiting the third-party utilities' scopes and credentials.
